Package com.compdfkit.core.signature

Class CPDFAwsKmsSigner

java.lang.Object
com.compdfkit.core.signature.CPDFAwsKmsSigner
public final class CPDFAwsKmsSigner extends Object
Creates PDF signatures and retrieves public-key material using AWS KMS.

Initialize the SDK before calling these synchronous methods and run them on a worker thread. The KMS transport currently has no configurable timeout, retry, proxy or cancellation API. Operations require the explicit connection and credential settings described by CPDFAwsKmsConfig.

sign(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, com.compdfkit.core.signature.CPDFSignatureOptions, com.compdfkit.core.signature.CPDFAwsKmsConfig) creates an ordinary detached PKCS#7 signature. The current binding does not create PAdES signed attributes, embedded timestamps or LTV evidence for KMS signatures; signPades(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, com.compdfkit.core.signature.CPDFPadesOptions, com.compdfkit.core.signature.CPDFAwsKmsConfig) reports that limitation.

  • Method Details

    • sign

      public static CPDFSignatureCreateResult sign(String input, String output, CPDFSignatureOptions options, CPDFAwsKmsConfig config)
      Signs a saved PDF in a new signature field using the configured KMS key.

      The output must differ from the input, must not already exist, and must have an existing writable parent directory. Save document edits before calling; this entry point has no PDF-open-password parameter. The certificate must match an RSA KMS key of at least 2048 bits.

      Creation and verification are reported separately. When post-sign verification is enabled, inspect CPDFSignatureCreateResult.getValidationResult() even if creation succeeded. This operation does not establish PAdES-LT or LTA.

      Parameters:
      input - the readable source PDF path
      output - the new signed PDF path
      options - signature-field and verification settings; null uses defaults
      config - KMS settings with credentials and a matching certificate, unless fallback is enabled; null produces a configuration error
      Returns:
      the creation result, published path and diagnostics; validation is included when enabled

    • signPades

      public static CPDFPadesResult signPades(String input, String signed, String ltv, String lta, CPDFPadesOptions options, CPDFAwsKmsConfig config)
      Reports that PAdES signing with KMS is unsupported in the current binding.

      This method always returns sdk.kms.pades_unsupported. It does not contact KMS or create output files. The current external-signature container cannot build the PAdES attributes and timestamps required by this workflow. Use sign(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, com.compdfkit.core.signature.CPDFSignatureOptions, com.compdfkit.core.signature.CPDFAwsKmsConfig) for the supported ordinary detached signature operation.

      Parameters:
      input - the intended source PDF path; unused
      signed - the intended signed-stage output path; unused
      ltv - the intended LT output path; unused
      lta - the intended LTA output path; unused
      options - the intended PAdES settings; unused
      config - the intended KMS settings; unused
      Returns:
      a failed result with error code sdk.kms.pades_unsupported

    • getPublicKey

      public static CPDFKmsDataResult getPublicKey(CPDFAwsKmsConfig config)
      Fetches and parses the public key for the configured KMS key.

      The result contains DER-encoded X.509 SubjectPublicKeyInfo. No private-key material is returned, and no signer certificate is required in the configuration.

      Parameters:
      config - the KMS connection and credential settings; null produces a configuration error
      Returns:
      public-key DER on success, or errors and an empty data array on failure

    • generateCsr

      public static CPDFKmsDataResult generateCsr(CPDFAwsKmsConfig config)
      Builds a PKCS#10 certificate signing request using the configured KMS key.

      The request uses CPDFAwsKmsConfig.setCommonName(String) for its subject, is signed through KMS, and has its signature checked before success is reported. The result is DER, not PEM. Submit the CSR to a CA to obtain a certificate; this operation does not issue a CA certificate or export the private key.

      Parameters:
      config - the KMS connection, credential and common-name settings; no signer certificate is required
      Returns:
      CSR DER on success, or errors and an empty data array on failure
